content.title: About
content.content: Passion fruit juice, 100% is a completely natural beverage made from ripe passion fruit (Passiflora edulis). It has a bright aroma, sweet‑tart flavor, and is rich in vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Passion fruit originates from tropical South America but is now cultivated in Asia, Africa, and the Caribbean.
The juice is widely used in sauces, desserts, and cocktails.
Passion fruit contains over 30 % dietary fiber, supporting digestive health.
Its tropical scent is often associated with summer vacation drinks.
Passion fruit juice is also used in cosmetics for its moisturizing and soothing properties.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system and aids collagen synthesis, improving skin health.

items.title: Contains vitamin A
items.content: Vitamin A is essential for vision and the health of mucous membranes.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potassium helps regulate fluid balance and supports normal heart function.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Flavonoids and carotenoids protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Dietary fiber promotes regular bowel movements and may reduce constipation.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to passion fruit.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity can irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis or ulcers.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although the juice is 100% natural, inherent sugars can affect blood glucose levels.

items.title: Quality control
items.content: Choose juice without added preservatives or artificial flavors.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the juice chilled, use it in smoothies, cocktails, marinades, sauces for fish and seafood, as well as in desserts and yogurt.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the juice in the refrigerator at 0 °C to 4 °C. After opening, consume within 3–5 days. Avoid freezing, as it may alter flavor and texture.
